faqs.q: Sec. 90-37. - Waste collection services accounting and budgeting.
faqs.a:
The finance director shall segregate waste collection services, expenses and revenues
               separate from the general fund expenditures and revenues and provide a general accounting
               for the expenditures and revenues. For each budget cycle, a projection of residential
               waste collection services expenditures and revenues shall be made as part of the city
               budget process.
(Ord. No.
4733
, § 1, 6-15-2020)
